# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
completed_orders['revenue_clean'] = completed_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Final validation: ensure all values are valid and within expected range
# Check for NaN, inf, negative values
invalid_mask = ~completed_orders['revenue_clean'].apply(lambda x: isinstance(x, (int, float)) and not (x != x))

if invalid_mask.any():
    print('Invalid values found in cleaned revenue column')
else:
    print('All cleaned revenue values are valid')

# Check min and max
print(f'Min revenue: {completed_orders["revenue_clean"].min()}')
print(f'Max revenue: {completed_orders["revenue_clean"].max()}')

# Compute mean
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}')"}}
